content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Agricultural Field Operator Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the ICAR CRRI AFO recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) posts at ICAR CRRI, Cuttack is scheduled for 24th August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Matriculation with +2 Vocational in Agriculture related subject or possess Matriculation with two years of working experience in agricultural field work from a reputed organization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the AFO position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post is between 18 years and 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) position announced by ICAR CRRI, Cuttack.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) recruitment at ICAR CRRI, Cuttack. All categories of candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AFO recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post will involve a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI AFO recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ICAR CRRI office in Cuttack, Odisha. The exact address and reporting time will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) position is a contractual role. It is not a permanent government job.
